feedback: The app does not work at all.
expected_behavior: A broad application-functionality failure is supported; do not invent a specific broken feature.

feedback: Checkout fails every time I pay.
expected_behavior: Represent checkout or payment failure.

feedback: Checkout fails, but search works great.
expected_behavior: Preserve the negative checkout experience and positive search experience separately; do not collapse them into an ambiguous combined label.

feedback: The app is fast and easy to use.
expected_behavior: Represent speed and usability; a broader positive user-experience theme may pass only if both meanings remain clear.

feedback: I used the app yesterday.
expected_behavior: Do not invent a product problem, benefit, or feature-specific theme.

feedback: This could be better.
expected_behavior: A broad improvement or dissatisfaction theme is acceptable; do not invent a cause or affected feature.

feedback: I hate this app!
expected_behavior: Preserve general dissatisfaction without inventing a specific defect.

feedback: All my saved data disappeared.
expected_behavior: Represent data loss; do not soften it into generic usability.

feedback: Login is slow and checkout crashes.
expected_behavior: A broader performance or reliability theme may represent both related failures.

feedback: I waited 10 minutes for the page to load.
expected_behavior: Represent page-loading slowness; do not invent the technical cause.

feedback: Reports take forever to open and dashboard images load late.
expected_behavior: A broader performance theme is acceptable because both experiences concern slowness.

feedback: My invoice total is wrong, although the help documentation is excellent.
expected_behavior: Preserve the billing-accuracy problem and positive documentation experience separately.

feedback: Notifications arrive late, but dark mode looks excellent.
expected_behavior: Preserve notification delay and positive dark-mode experience separately.

feedback: PDF export works perfectly.
expected_behavior: Represent successful export or export reliability; do not invent an export failure.

feedback: Audio stutters and videos keep buffering.
expected_behavior: A broader media-performance theme may represent both playback problems.

feedback: The app crashes when I save. The total on my invoice is wrong. Support was very helpful.
expected_behavior: Preserve the save crash, invoice-accuracy problem, and positive support experience; grouping must not hide any of them.

feedback: Setup instructions are confusing, but the onboarding tooltips are helpful.
expected_behavior: Preserve both negative instructions and positive tooltips; a mixed onboarding theme passes only if the contrast remains visible.

feedback: Mobile navigation is intuitive, but the desktop layout is broken.
expected_behavior: Preserve the positive mobile and negative desktop experiences, including their platform distinction.

feedback: The password-reset link expires before the reset email arrives.
expected_behavior: A broader account-recovery failure may represent the linked timing and expiration problems.

feedback: Search results are irrelevant and there are no useful filters.
expected_behavior: A broader search/discovery theme may represent both related problems.

feedback: Pricing is confusing, even though the app runs very fast.
expected_behavior: Preserve pricing clarity and positive performance separately.

feedback: Love it—best app ever!
expected_behavior: A broad positive satisfaction theme is supported; do not invent a specific product benefit.

feedback: I cannot use keyboard shortcuts.
expected_behavior: Represent missing or unusable keyboard shortcuts.

feedback: The ads are annoying and the app drains my battery.
expected_behavior: Preserve advertising annoyance and battery usage separately; a generic bad-experience theme is too lossy.

feedback: JPG uploads fail, but PNG uploads work.
expected_behavior: Preserve the format-specific difference within image upload; do not label all uploads as broken or successful.

feedback: Support took three days to reply and still did not resolve my issue.
expected_behavior: A broader support-quality theme may represent both slow response and unresolved outcome.

feedback: Why does a calculator app need access to my contacts?
expected_behavior: Represent a privacy or unnecessary-permissions concern without claiming misuse occurred.

feedback: Please add calendar synchronization.
expected_behavior: Represent a calendar-integration feature request; do not turn it into an existing defect.

feedback: Text contrast is too low and screen-reader buttons have no labels.
expected_behavior: A broader accessibility theme may represent both problems if visual contrast and screen-reader labeling remain supported.

feedback: My saved filters disappear. Export is reliable. The dashboard looks beautiful.
expected_behavior: Preserve filter persistence, positive export reliability, and positive dashboard design as distinct experiences.
